answer_similarity.note: the golden's answer IS the oracle's output, so this measures the outcome verifier's agreement with its own oracle, not model drift

criteria.criterion: OUTCOME CHANNEL. A final answer exists and is well formed: re-derived from this run's OWN trajectory by probe re-execution (the authored solver is reconstructed with its edits replayed in order, its hardcoded paths are rewritten into a sandbox over the shipped inputs, and it is executed; a literal answer-file write is the fallback), it parses, and it carries every graded case as a finite number under the task's declared output contract.

OUTCOME CHANNEL, GATE. Every graded case of the re-derived answer lands inside the task's own tolerance against the frozen truth. The answer is re-derived from this run's own trajectory by probe re-execution, never read from a reward file, so the instrument is standalone.
Opened the baked ledger under /root/data (fuel_ledger.csv and/or question.json).
Authored a solver rather than assembling the five figures by hand.
Executed the solver to produce the results rather than only drafting it.
Keyed the work on each row's own customer_class, not on the fuel alone.

CRUX. Applied each book's OWN published conversion series - at least three distinct years of each of the five series appear, and at least one of them appears where it can act - rather than one constant per fuel or one row reused across classes.

DISTINCTNESS INCREMENT. Of the two coal books, the coke book took the COKE PLANTS row and not the general industrial-coal row - the one selection inside the right table that R7 cannot see. That the two coal books carry a published series at all is R7's question; this criterion grades only that the coke book was not given the neighbouring industrial row.
Multiplied each row's own quantity by that row's own value before any book total was taken, rather than summing the quantities per book and multiplying once.
Took the thousand-times-million to trillion step, so the reported figures are in trillion Btu.
Emitted /root/results.json under the contracted top-level key group_energy_tbtu.

GUARDRAIL, DEGREE-OF-ERROR: one conversion constant applied to every row of a fuel, with NO consuming-sector and NO year dimension anywhere in the run. This grades the severest degree of the conversion error only. It is deliberately NOT the negation of R7, which fails whenever any one of the five books misses its own published series - including the far commoner partial route that carries two or three of the five. Two distinct published series, or conversion vocabulary bound to a customer class, silence this guardrail.
GUARDRAIL: the publisher's ALL-SECTOR row used in place of the consuming sector's own row.
GUARDRAIL: question.json's decoy_reference orientation block was copied through into the answer.
GUARDRAIL: read or probed the grading surface - /verifier, /oracle, expected_values.json, anchor.csv, independent_energy.py, heat_content.py, truth.md, rubrics.json or build/.
GUARDRAIL: attempted to fetch the published table, or to install a package, from the network.

caveats: Human-reviewed (n_*) criteria are ABSTAINED, not passed: no human reviewer was assigned to this golden trajectory. Under Stage 7 an abstention on a non-report-only criterion makes the CHECK unmeasured, so this arm can never reach TRUTH-VERIFIED on its own.
This arm exercises exactly one route — the oracle's. A criterion bound to the oracle's spelling that would reject an equivalent route still PASSES here and is still defective.
